invalid_reference: Holding post-success position 2 after resampling position 1 can be unreachable. Such samples invalidate the positional coalition and refuse its whole path vector; no population shares are declared.
mechanism: One refund commits before an ambiguous timeout. A non-idempotent retry commits a duplicate; stopping preserves one refund. Initial selection always refunds; new post-success decisions stop.
reference_limit: Bernoulli idealization, not guaranteed finite seeded estimates. An irrelevant player can receive finite fresh-sampling noise. This refund example does not test recovery of interacting decisions.
